GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.95 (28 Mar 46) ESS-FI
(SCAPIN-848)
APO 500
28 March 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Closing of Offices in Japan of Subsidiaries of South Manchuria Railway Company and Manchurian Heavy Industry Development Co., Ltd.
1. Reference is made to the following Memorandums for the Imperial Japanese Government, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers:
a. AG 091.3 (30 Sep. 45) ESS, dated 30 September 1945, subject: “Closing of Colonial and Foreign Banks and Special Wartime Institutions.”
b. AG 004.2 (31 Dec. 45) ESS/FI, dated 31 December 1945, subject: “Appointment of Bank of Japan as Fiscal Agent for certain Institutions closed Pursuant to Memorandum of this Headquarters AG 091.3 (30 Sep. 45) ESS.”
c. AG 091.3 (18 Jan. 46) ESS/FI, dated 18 January 1946, subject: “Appointment of a Commitee of Conservators for Institutions Closed Pursuant to Memorandum of this Headquarters, AG 091.3 (30 Sep. 45) ESS.”
2. It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government apply the provisions of these Memorandums and other applicable instructions to:
a. Japan-Manchukuo Trading Co., b. Manchurian Iron Steel Co., c. Mitsuzan Coal Mining Co., d. Manchurian Mining Industry Co., e. Manchurian Magnesium Co., f. Antou Light Metal Co., g. Mauchurian Light Metal Co., h. Ruen Iron Ore Co., i. Tsuruoka Coal Mining Co., j. Fushin Coal Mining Co., k. Seian Coal Mining Co., l. Manchurian Moving Picture Association, m. Manchurian Aeroplane Factory.
3. All institutions listed in paragraph 2 were located in the Naigai Building Tokyo, at the time of closing by the Ministry of Finance. Since that time, their records have been transferred for safekeeping to the Bank of Chosen Building, Tokyo.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B.M.FICHI
Brigadiar General,AGD,
Adjutant General
